The plugin can be installed inside IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate via one of the following options:
1. Settings > Plugins > Marketplace
2. Visiting the JetBrains Marketplace: https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/18504-apache-grails
3. Settings > Plugins & choosing "Install Plugin from Disk"

Apache Grails website: https://grails.apache.org/
